description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing functionalities. It also includes a nested class TimedInfo for managing scheduled content and a TimerType::TimeWorker class for thread execution. Additionally, it defines a template class WatchDogType for thread-based watchdog timers. The file includes necessary headers and manages internal synchronization and thread control.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a scheduled timer with functionalities to schedule, trigger, revoke, and process timed content, with internal thread management.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimedInfo
classes.description: A helper class representing scheduled information with a timestamp and content.

classes.name: TimerType<CONTENT>::TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class responsible for executing timer processing in a separate thread.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A template class implementing a watchdog timer thread that can be armed, reset, and run a handler.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a content item to be triggered at a specific time.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all scheduled entries and stops the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content item is scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a specific content item at a given time, rescheduling if necessary.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a scheduled content item from the timer.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled items.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop for the timer thread, handling scheduled items and delays.
